steps.name: phone-design
steps.summary: Phone design written in docs/UI_GUIDE.md "Phone design" (palette, surfaces with shadow-card and no dark outlines, buttons with one filled primary per screen, lucide-react icons, 16/20/24/32 type with 400/600/700, 64px app bar, bubbles and status pills, cart card, suggestions, <=150px dock, P4/P5/P6). Tokens in the phone @theme block of src/app/globals.css (kibo-tint, kibo-bubble, kibo-deep, field, staff-*, online, rounded-tile/sheet, shadow-card/dock, kibo-sheet-in); IBM Plex Sans KR weight 600 added. Presentational components in src/components/phone/ (ui.ts class strings, AppBar, Conversation Bubble/StatusChip, OrderCard/OrderLines/OrderTotal, Suggestions, Dock with TypingSheet and voiceActive, Checkout ConfirmCard/ConfirmBar/PayCard/DoneCard), NOT wired into /assistant yet. Dev-only preview /design/phone (404 in production, checked) with MALO sample data; e2e/qa/design.qa.spec.ts checks 9 frames at 390x844 and 360x800 plus 3 Korean frames, and the dock height <=150px: 0 H, 0 T. Deviations from the step: the language button shows the full name (English/한국어), not EN/한, because a short code failed WCAG 2.5.3 label-in-name in Korean (I-162); suggestions are 20px (phone body size), not 18px. New phone.ts keys: staffShort, connected, barReconnecting, closeTyping, itemCount(). lint, build, test (807 passed), qa:ui 27/27 pass.

steps.name: phone-redesign
steps.summary: AssistantPanel (/assistant and /demo) now renders every phone screen with the step 0 components: AppBar (connection dot+word replaces the reconnecting banner; Staff compact button), Messages/LastMessage/StatusChip, new phone/Choices.tsx (white photo cards), OrderCard, Suggestions, Dock (replaces the always-on text input: [Type] opens the field, it stays open for the order until [Close]; P1 [Type instead], in-app [Order here by typing] and voice fallback open and focus it; /demo opens it at start), ConfirmBar/ConfirmCard (P4; learned confirm keeps its total in the card plus the dock), PayCard (P5), DoneCard (P6; proportional figures + 0.04em tracking). Screens: P-start, P1 mic/in-app, P2, P3 (all voice/text/error/choice states), P4 (+typing), P5, P6, P7, PX idle/staff/reconnecting, learned pending/slow/mismatch/confirm, ticket wording. Behavior unchanged (same commands, sources, aria-live). Orchestrator fixes: mic label says what a tap does per state (Tap to talk / Tap to cancel / Tap to end voice, state named first for screen readers; micStop removed), switch shows Voice on/Voice off (on/off keys removed), order number proportional. /demo chrome: phone frame, ActionStrip, ScenarioGuide (cream column, white scenario cards, tinted tags/chips/step numbers, white [Scenarios] pill), DemoEndCard, CompareCard lose dark outlines; kiosk half untouched. Deleted assistant/CartCard, ChoiceButtons, Conversation, VoiceControls; styles.ts trimmed (CHIP, SMALL) and kept only for landing, D1, mic-test (I-165). Tests: assistant.qa closes the sticky field before P4-confirm; checks.ts screenshot waits for kibo-sheet-in (I-163). Before/after: Undo and staff are quiet/compact instead of 2px-outlined pills; the cart total sits in a white shadowed card with a hairline instead of a 2px ink rule; P3 bottom went from mic pill + switch + always-on input (~170px) to one dock with an 88px round mic (~150px closed). lint, build, test 807 passed, test:e2e 19 passed/14 @live skipped, qa:ui 27/27 (0 H). Docs: UI_GUIDE Phone design (dock, P4, P6, /demo surfaces), UX C3, UI_QA, ISSUE I-163..I-165.

steps.name: pwa-shell
steps.summary: Installable phone app. src/app/manifest.ts (/manifest.webmanifest: KIBO, start_url /app, scope /, standalone, cream bg, KIBO blue theme, lang en, icons public/icons/icon-192/512 + maskable-512 + apple-touch-icon from scripts/make-icons.mjs with sharp); root layout adds apple icon, appleWebApp and apple-mobile-web-app-capable. public/sw.js caches only public/offline.html (static ko+en page) and answers only /app navigations with no network; registered by src/components/app/ServiceWorker.tsx from /app and /assistant only, production builds only, with scope /app (so /assistant, /api and SSE never pass through it); next.config.ts serves /sw.js no-cache. /app home (src/app/app/AppHome.tsx, P0): logo, tagline, [Scan a kiosk] 88px primary linking to /app/scan (404 until step 3), [Continue my order] secondary only while a live order is stored, How it works (3 steps), Settings (language halves with check mark, AI voice and Larger text switches). Settings logic in src/lib/phone/settings.ts (keys kibo.phone.locale (unchanged), .aiVoice, .largeText on/off, .lastOrder {sessionId,status,expiresAt}; resumeHref hides paid/expired/past-expiry/no-device-token/broken records; 11 unit tests written first) and src/hooks/usePhoneSettings.ts (shared store, sets html lang and root font-size 115% for larger text). /assistant (AssistantApp) reads the settings, writes the lastOrder record, and passes AI voice as new optional controlled props voiceOutput/onVoiceOutputChange of AssistantPanel (/demo unchanged). New phone.ts keys appTagline, scanKiosk, continueOrder, howTitle, appStep1-3, settings, language, largeText, settingOn/Off. Tests: e2e/app.spec.ts (settings reach /assistant, Continue appears and disappears after payment; X-Forwarded-For 192.0.2.41), e2e/qa/app.qa.spec.ts (P0-home and P0-home-continue-ko-large, top and settings, 4 phone sizes, reflow; 192.0.2.40; 0 H; larger text has rem spacing T misses by design, I-166). scripts/pwa-check.ts (npm run pwa:check, production standalone build): manifest fields and PNG icons, Chromium Page.getInstallabilityErrors and getAppManifest errors empty, SW scope /app, /app controlled, /assistant not controlled, /api/health not fromServiceWorker, Cache Storage only /offline.html, offline page shown with server stopped: all 13 pass. Docs: UX screen map P0, ARCHITECTURE pages, SECURITY, UI_GUIDE Home (P0), UI_QA, ISSUE I-166. Next step note: next.config.ts Permissions-Policy still has camera=(), which blocks an in-app QR scanner. lint, build, test 818 passed, test:e2e 20 passed/14 @live skipped (evidence files it rewrote were restored, I-099), qa:ui 28/28.

steps.name: pairing
steps.summary: A. Pairing code (tests first): POST /api/session returns a 6-digit pairCode for every non-demo session (kiosk only); stored as pairCodes/{code} {sessionId, expiresAt = issue + 1 h, Timestamp for TTL} via SessionStore.reservePairCode (transaction, refuses a live entry, replaces an expired one; up to 5 draws, service reservePairCode) and as the plain digits in sessionSecrets.pairCode (a hash of 6 digits protects nothing; rotation must find the old entry). POST /api/session/pair {code: 6 digits} = same result as a claim ({sessionId, deviceToken, status}; CONFLICT 'Someone else is using this kiosk.', GONE, NOT_FOUND 'That code doesn't match a kiosk. Check the number on the kiosk screen.' for wrong/used/rotated/>1 h codes); single use (claim sets pairCode null, then the entry is deleted); new per-IP limit kind 'pair' 10/min (bad bodies count). reissueClaim rotates the code (result.pairCode + top-level pairCode in the command route; unused new code or replaced old code deleted after the transaction; never kept in recentResults). claimSession/pairSession share claimWith. Kiosk: useKioskSession stores pairCode; pairCode prop threaded KioskScreen -> Attract/Menu/Review/Payment/KioskToolbar; onClaimUrl(claimUrl, pairCode); new src/components/kiosk/PairCode.tsx under the QR on K1 and in the QR sheet ('또는 휴대폰에서 이 주소를 열고 / <host>/app / 이 번호를 넣으세요' + '연결 번호' 72px '123 456', host from the claim URL). PUBLIC_ORIGIN env (publicOrigin uses it when a valid http(s) origin); scripts/deploy.sh reads the project number with gcloud projects describe and sets PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://kibo-<number>.asia-northeast3.run.app (deploy.test.ts updated). /app: pairing card is now the primary (label, numeric one-time-code field 32px digits, strips non-digits so '123 456' works, [Connect] 88px primary), stores kibo.phone.<id> and router.push('/assistant?s=<id>'); [Scan a kiosk] became secondary under 'Or connect with the QR'; appStep1 copy updated; InAppNote (src/components/app/InAppNote.tsx) on /app and /app/scan. B. Scanner: next.config.ts sends camera=(self) only on /app/scan (later header entry wins, per Next docs; scripts/next-config.test.ts + E2E header check). src/lib/phone/kioskQr.ts parseKioskQr(text, origin) (tests first: exact origin, /assistant, SESSION_ID s, #t= token <=128, <=512 chars; foreign vs malformed) + assistantHref rebuilds the link. src/lib/phone/qrDecode.ts: BarcodeDetector(qr_code) else jsqr (npm install jsqr 1.4.0, Apache-2.0) on an in-memory canvas <=640px, ~8 fps. src/app/app/scan (ScanApp): camera hint like the mic hint, getUserMedia(environment) only after the tap, framing square, torch toggle when supported, 'This QR is not a KIBO kiosk.', unavailable state with camera-app advice + paste-link field, camera stopped on success/pagehide/hidden/unmount, vibrate then window.location.assign so /assistant's claim and P1 run. Tests: service/store/route/http/deploy/next-config/kioskQr unit tests; e2e/app-pair.spec.ts (192.0.2.42): headers, kiosk code typed on /app (wrong, short, spaced, single use, kiosk moves to K2), scanner with a generated Y4M QR video as Chromium's fake camera (e2e/qrVideo.ts; foreign refused with no requests sent, kiosk QR claims and is the only POST), no-camera paste path. QA: e2e/qa/scan.qa.spec.ts (192.0.2.43, 5 states x 4 phone sizes), P0-home-pair-error, KX-qr-sheet; all 0 H. Docs: ARCHITECTURE (routes, endpoints, pages, NOT_FOUND, sessionSecrets.pairCode, new pairCodes collection, limits, PUBLIC_ORIGIN), SECURITY (pairing code guarded by rate limit/single use/1 h/TTL, scanner), OPERATIONS (PUBLIC_ORIGIN; TTL command for pairCodes.expiresAt, to be enabled by a person), UX (A2, P0, P0-scan, in-app), UI_GUIDE (Home, Scanner, kiosk pairing line), UI_QA, ISSUE I-167 (long production host wraps, user decides on a custom domain), I-168 (no global cap on distributed guessing), I-169 (P1 hint follows a seen flag, not mic permission). lint, build, test 841 passed/1 skipped, test:e2e 24 passed/14 @live skipped (rewritten evidence restored, I-099), qa:ui 30/30.
